title: Venato Prime
extract:
Venato Prime is the Primed counterpart of the  Venato scythe, acting as a direct upgrade and has the ability to apply  Tau status when applying another Status Effect. Venato Prime was released alongside  Caliban Prime and  Vadarya Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Applying a Status Effect has a 100% chance to proc a  Tau status.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Stalking Fan stance.
Can use the Venato-exclusive  Sentient Incision mod.
Innate  polarity.
When wielded by  Caliban/ Caliban Prime, attacks have a 50% chance to generate an additional Melee Combo point.
